scientific_finding: Retrieval Audit Finding: When audited globally across all relations, retrieval achieves 90.0%. When strictly isolated WITHIN the same relation (where both query and gallery share the exact same relation type, chance baseline = 50.0%), entity discrimination accuracy is 90.00% (Recall@5 = 97.78%), significantly outperforming language heuristics (46.11%) and permutation (10.00%). However, representation similarity between different entities within the same relation (0.8488) is nearly as high as within-entity similarity (0.8548), indicating that the representation space is overwhelmingly dominated by the relation.
